page_title: ROM 1-0 FIO | AS Roma v Fiorentina 04/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match is over and Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) gets a red card for unsporting behaviour.
90+6' Daniele Chiffi is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+6' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) takes the free kick from the edge of the box and fires the ball goalwards. The goalkeeper can stay calm as the shot sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
90+5' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Lucas Gourna-Douath (AS Roma). Fiorentina have a free kick.
90+4' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+2' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul.
90+1' Matias Soule (AS Roma) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
90+1' The ball is cleared after Manu Kone (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. AS Roma will have a chance to score from a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Matias Soule (AS Roma) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
90' It's time for a substitution. Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) comes on in place of Cher Ndour.

90' A pass lands at the feet of Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
89' Matias Soule (AS Roma) works the corner short.
89' Matias Soule (AS Roma) is booked by the referee.
88' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. AS Roma win a corner kick.
85' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Moise Kean (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Daniele Chiffi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

83' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Moise Kean (Fiorentina) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Mile Svilar pulls off a brilliant save.
83' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
81' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
81' A cross from Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Fiorentina will have a corner.
80' The resulting set piece from Fiorentina is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
77' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Zeki Celik will be replaced by Devyne Rensch (AS Roma).
77' Artem Dovbyk comes off the pitch to be replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
75' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
73' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
72' Lucas Gourna-Douath (AS Roma) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender.
71' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) replacing Amir Richardson.
71' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Marin Pongracic as he is replaced by Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina).
70' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.

68' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.

66' Well-positioned Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the middle, but Mile Svilar reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
65' The substitution is prepared. Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Eldor Shomurodov.
65' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Bryan Cristante and he is replaced by Lucas Gourna-Douath (AS Roma).
64' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) will replace Nicolo Zaniolo.
60' The corner from Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is intercepted by Mile Svilar.

60' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fiorentina will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
57' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
54' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Mile Svilar comes off the line to clear the ball away.

52' Excellent touch by Amir Richardson (Fiorentina)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
49' Matias Soule (AS Roma) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Daniele Chiffi saw the whole situation.
47' Manu Kone (AS Roma) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the top right corner, but David de Gea is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
46' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
46' The game is over for Robin Gosens. Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) comes on for the second half.
46' Claudio Ranieri has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) comes on the pitch for Lorenzo Pellegrini.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' 1 - 0 Goal! Nice headed pass by Eldor Shomurodov to Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma), who latches on to it and puts the ball into the back of the net with a fine header. 1:0.
45+4' AS Roma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+4' Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) sends a rebound goalwards towards the top of the net, but the goalkeeper is there in time to stop it. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
45+3' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) tries to find Robin Gosens, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

45+1' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Mile Svilar was alert and the score remained the same.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
42' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Daniele Chiffi signals.
40' 4:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.
38' Manu Kone (AS Roma) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
37' Manu Kone (AS Roma) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
36' Matias Soule (AS Roma) swings in a cross from the corner, but David de Gea reads it well and gathers the ball.
35' A corner kick by AS Roma is thwarted by the well prepared David de Gea (Fiorentina). The ball goes out for a corner. AS Roma can continue in their attacking effort.

34' A pass into the box finds Zeki Celik (AS Roma) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the roof of the net, but a brilliant last-ditch save by David de Gea denies him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to AS Roma.
32' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
30' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.

27' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Mile Svilar shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
25' Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) passes the ball onto Moise Kean, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
25' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is able to continue to play.
23' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
22' The linesman raises his flag. Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is adjudged offside.
18' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina).

17' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play and Fiorentina manage to earn a corner.

15' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
14' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) is penalised for holding. Daniele Chiffi signals a set piece.
11' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
10' A pass from Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is intercepted by Mile Svilar and the move breaks down.
9' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
6' Some great controlled play and passing from AS Roma. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
4' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
3' He should have scored! Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. AS Roma win a corner.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Daniele Chiffi will supervise the game today.
